_comment: 机器可读的第三方清单：与 THIRD_PARTY.md 逐行对应，窗口的「包完整性」卡按它渲染。licenses/ 是随包走的许可证原文，source 是可核验的上游地址。

components.name: msys-2.0.dll
components.whyZh: tio.exe 的 PE import：MSYS/POSIX 层本身
components.whyEn: a PE import of tio.exe: the MSYS/POSIX layer itself

components.name: msys-glib-2.0-0.dll · msys-iconv-2.dll · msys-pcre2-8-0.dll · msys-lua-5.5.dll · msys-intl-8.dll
components.whyZh: tio 及其运行库的 PE import（GLib/iconv/pcre2/lua/intl）
components.whyEn: PE imports of tio and its runtime (GLib/iconv/pcre2/lua/intl)

components.name: msys-gcc_s-seh-1.dll
components.whyZh: msys-2.0.dll 的 PE import（异常展开）
components.whyEn: a PE import of msys-2.0.dll (exception unwinding)

components.name: tio.exe (引导器) · TioApp.dll (窗口)
components.whyZh: 本插件的引导器与窗口
components.whyEn: the launcher and the window of this plugin

components.name: Windows Terminal
components.whyZh: 只调用机器上已装的，不把「本机存在」当成「可再分发」
components.whyEn: only the machine's own install is called; "installed here" is never taken as "redistributable"

components.name: Qt 6.12 (Core/Gui/Qml/Quick/QuickControls2)
components.whyZh: 用 Win顺 宿主的共享 Qt（qt: host），包内不混入另一版
components.whyEn: the host's shared Qt is used (qt: host); no second Qt ships inside the package

components.name: Phosphor 字体（图标字形）
components.whyZh: 图标字形来源；包里只有生成产物（app.ico、icons/app-*.png）
components.whyEn: glyph source for the icons; only generated artefacts ship (app.ico, icons/app-*.png)
